Clause 4 is `-4 3 3 0`: ingest_clause dedupes it to the BINARY (3 v -4) and stores it under input id 4, while the checker holds a three-entry clause under that id. It rejects the moment a chain uses id 4 as a PROPAGATING antecedent for the duplicated literal (`multiple literals unassigned in hint 4: 3 3`), which is the normal case in conflict analysis: an antecedent propagates a literal that was resolved away and so is NOT in the lemma, hence not masked as falsified. A repeat that IS falsified at check time -- e.g. when the chain uses the clause as the CONFLICT, or when the duplicated literal is the lemma's own -- passes, which is why only some duplicate-carrying instances ever failed and why the whole class needed enumerating rather than patching the unit case.
